title: Terranigma RPG's Trailer Reveals January 14 Release
content: Publisher Clear River Games began streaming on Wednesday a trailer for Quintet's 1995 RPG Terranigma , and it reveals that it will release the game for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and GOG on January 14, 2027.
author: ANN

title: Mega Man: Dual Override Game's Video Previews Dual Protagonists, Custom Chips, Special Weapons, Override, Pragmata DLC
content: CAPCOM unveiled during its CAPCOM Spotlight livestream on Wednesday footage for Mega Man: Dual Override , a new game in its Mega Man series, and highlights the different playstyles for the two main playable characters: the balanced Mega Man and the stronger close-range attacker Protoman.
author: ANN

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Reveals New Look at Returning Favorites Ahead of October Debut
content: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 is set to make its debut later this October, and the anime has shared a closer look at the returning fan favorite characters ahead of its big comeback.
author: ComicBook

title: Major Crunchyroll Isekai Returns With Brand New Look Ahead of Season Finale
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is right around the corner, which means fans will have to bid farewell to some of their favorite Summer 2026 shows. It was an exciting season for isekai fans, especially since some of the biggest Crunchyroll series were airing at the same time.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon's Dogma 2 Game's Trailer Previews 'Dark Arisen' Expansion
content: CAPCOM unveiled during the CAPCOM Spotlight livestream on Wednesday the main trailer for the Dragon's Dogma 2 sequel game's upcoming "Dark Arisen" expansion : The game will launch on Nintendo Switch 2 on October 9. The Switch 2 release will include the base game and the new "Dark Arisen" expansion.
author: ANN

title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance Game Expansion's Trailer Reveals Teostra, Previews Boost Drivers
content: CAPCOM unveiled during the CAPCOM Spotlight livestream on Wednesday an extended version of its trailer for the upcoming Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance expansion for its Monster Hunter Wilds game, and the end of the video teases the Elder Dragon Teostra.

title: South Park Makes Promising Change for Season 29 & It’s Not Just Its New Name
content: South Park is finally coming back for Season 29 of the animated series, and the first episode of this new season sets up a promising shift for the new episodes that goes deeper than just its name change.

title: Japan-French Co-Production 'Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar' Announced for Fall 2026
content: An official website opened for an original television anime co-produced by Japan and France titled Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar , and it revealed the main cast, staff, and a key visual (pictured) on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on October 2 at 9:25 p.m. on Tokyo MX.
